claims.finding: Tesla describes fan+ground-sealing and cold-gas systems; Rocket has perimeter thrusters. Manufacturer claim, not independent test certification.
claims.required_change: Keep with attribution; do not transplant Thrust/performance model layout to Rocket.

claims.finding: V6 two central floor rotors are inferred schematic, not verified Roadster hardware. Patent claim1 describes an underbody inlet, pathway and rear outlet with one or more ducted fans. A patent does not prove the demonstrated implementation.
claims.required_change: Remove specific twin-floor-rotor cutaway. Show separate generic functional airflow diagram, not an alleged actual internal layout.

claims.finding: Fan downforce needs the low-pressure region to be maintained, with sealing/leakage management and continuous powered airflow.
claims.required_change: Explicitly include sealing, not fan-only magic.

claims.finding: Suction/adhesion is the pressure-difference mechanism. Saying it is NOT suction but pressure is a false dichotomy.
claims.required_change: Replace misconception card with a question about how suction works; call it pressure-difference adhesion.

claims.finding: Approximate resultant Fp=(p_out-p_gap)Aeff only for a simplified approximately uniform useful patch; exact resultant requires pressure integration.
claims.required_change: Use symbolic qualitative force, not measured CFD or calibrated magnitudes.

claims.finding: With n toward a flat ceiling and no other vertical loads, N=Fp-mg. Need Fp>mg for positive tyre load, not merely Fp=mg.
claims.required_change: Force arrows remain qualitative; no assertion of measured margin.

claims.finding: On a vertical wall in a simple model N≈Fp; steady climbing requires tyre traction to support gravity, with |Ft|≤mu*N as a simplified friction bound. The illustrated normal adhesion force is not tangential tyre drive; the full fan/exhaust system can have other aerodynamic components, not quantified here.
claims.required_change: Fans add normal load; tyre drive supplies tangential propulsion.

claims.finding: Moving on a curved track requires acceleration v²/R; static adhesion alone does not validate every moving pose.
claims.required_change: Preserve source-fitted poses as CG reconstruction, not physics-solved motion or measured performance.

claims.finding: Gravity stays world-down; pressure-load direction follows the nearby surface.
claims.required_change: Keep consistent vectors on wall/ceiling/airborne.

claims.finding: An opening increases leakage and reduces effective pressure support depending on fan flow and geometry. It is not a universal instantaneous zero at the first small opening.
claims.required_change: Replace pressure-difference instantly disappears with seal lost/adhesion weakens. After fully clearing the surface the old adhesion cannot provide the same support.

claims.finding: Cold-gas thrust does not require combustion; it does not mean an air-conditioning system or a specified cryogenic temperature.
claims.required_change: Use high-pressure gas/cold-gas propulsion; no flames, no invented gas species or temperature.

claims.finding: Exact tank count, capacities, pressure, liner, wall thickness and placement were not verified from accessible primary sources.
claims.required_change: Remove two claimed internal capsules; use a separate reservoir→control→nozzle functional schematic, explicitly not the car layout.

claims.finding: General COPV engineering describes composite overwrap and a fluid-retention barrier; that does not establish this Tesla vessel architecture/material/dimensions. The Tesla X COPV post was blocked in this audit.
claims.required_change: Discuss general concept only if labelled; do not infer Tesla BOM from NASA examples or inaccessible reposts.

claims.finding: Force on the vehicle is opposite exhaust momentum; a simplified thrust expression includes mass flow, exhaust velocity and exit-pressure term.
claims.required_change: Do not imply jets need to hit the floor or create downward suction.

claims.finding: Upward thrust does not guarantee upward velocity/acceleration. Net force and current velocity matter.
claims.required_change: Text: exhaust downward / reaction thrust upward, not inevitably car rises.

claims.finding: A nozzle being away from COM is insufficient if the thrust line passes through COM. tau=r×F; nonzero lever arm matters.
claims.required_change: Text: thrust line misses COM / produces torque. Net torque, not a single assumed nozzle, controls the full manoeuvre.

claims.finding: Tesla describes perimeter thrusters and fast electric actuators for Rocket attitude support. Actual valve/control laws and measured forces are not established here.
claims.required_change: Show a general torque mechanism; do not claim to reverse-engineer the complete controller.

claims.finding: Source-visible cables/lines exist; their support/control role is not established by our footage analysis.
claims.required_change: Retain the separate-demonstration card and visible-lines/unknown-role note; do not claim untethered proof.
claims.evidence_type: Observed in already available source frames; direct X page403 in current audit, not inferred from Tesla product page.

claims.finding: Stored gas provides finite total impulse; it may need replenishment. Exact endurance and replenishment mechanism/time not confirmed.
claims.required_change: Use reserve finite/needs replenishing, not irreversible fuel disappearance or invented flight seconds.

claims.finding: Under a low-pressure-rise, approximately incompressible steady-flow approximation, fluid power is DeltaP*Q; shaft/electric power is greater after efficiency losses. This is an independent work/energy derivation, not Tesla power data.
claims.required_change: Avoid implying passive/perpetual ceiling adhesion. No unsupported fan power figures.
claims.evidence_type: Independent mechanical derivation from pressure work; not a Tesla hardware measurement.

claims.finding: Car/ramp dimensions, nozzles and internal shapes are visually fitted/illustrative, not factoryCAD or validated structural analysis.
claims.required_change: Retain external source fit; remove unsupported hardware placement and claim only CG reconstruction.
claims.evidence_type: Direct local code audit; not a patent assertion about our model.

claims.finding: The official product page distinguishes Performance, Thrust and Rocket; they do not all have the same seating or thruster package.
claims.required_change: Do not call the flying demo a universal stock Roadster feature.

limitations: Official page available in web-search primary indexed text; direct open had minimal JS body.
Official X posts blocked403; no fresh direct confirmation of detailed COPV arrangement.
USPTO Gazette claim1 directly read; full patent GooglePatents endpoint unavailable; no inference that granted design equals built Roadster.
Local raw HTML/GIF archival failed SSL; web primary-source evidence remains available.
No factoryCAD, calibrated pressure/thrust/mass/inertia/time-series or full control data obtained.
